title: Zavelyn Automatic Chicken Coop Door

FEATURES

  • Automatic timer control: Set daily opening and closing times so the coop door handles the routine automatically without depending on changing daylight. Manual open and close controls are also available, helping owners manage special situations without resetting the programmed schedule.

  • Safer anti-jam operation: The door is designed to detect resistance during movement and respond instead of continuing to force the panel downward. This helps reduce the risk of trapping a chicken or obstruction in the doorway and adds reassurance during unattended automatic operation.

  • Battery powered convenience: Runs on 3 AA batteries, so there is no need to route a permanent power cable to the coop. A battery indicator provides a low-battery alert, while the low-power design supports extended standby and reduces the frequency of battery replacement.

  • Weather resistant outdoor design: Built for outdoor chicken-coop use, the door is designed to withstand rain and changing weather conditions, with product materials showing waterproof protection as well as resistance to cold, heat, snow, and dust for more dependable year-round use.

  • Easy cleaning and clear operation: The LCD screen displays the current time and programmed open and close times for quick checking. The exposed gear-track design is easier to access for cleaning, and the included cleaning brush helps remove dirt and debris that could interfere with smooth movement.
